units.text: The Constitution was signed on September 17, 1787, in Philadelphia, establishing the start date for the first period.

judgement.reason: The passage supports that the Constitution was signed on September 17, 1787, but does not mention Philadelphia or that this established the start date for the first period.

units.text: Congress proposed the Bill of Rights on September 25, 1789, marking the beginning of the second period.

judgement.reason: The passages support that Congress proposed/adopted the Bill of Rights on September 25, 1789, but none mentions or supports that this marked the beginning of a 'second period.'

units.text: The Bill of Rights was ratified on December 15, 1791, which ends both time periods under comparison.
